name: What does a plumber do to fix a gurgling drain?

mainEntity.name: What does a plumber do to fix a gurgling drain?

acceptedAnswer.text: When you call a plumber for a gurgling drain, they will typically start by diagnosing the cause. This often involves inspecting the drain and sometimes using a drain camera to locate clogs or inspect the condition of your pipes and vent system. Depending on the diagnosis, they might use a drain snake or auger to clear stubborn clogs. If the issue is with a vent pipe, they may clear blockages from the vent stack on your roof. For more complex issues like collapsed pipes or persistent blockages, hydro-jetting might be used.
acceptedAnswer.description: Plumbers diagnose the cause, often using cameras, then use tools like augers or hydro-jetting to clear clogs or vent issues.
